content: Higge asitamaaritaynnee Ferisaawitay iitatithi
Yeypp guye, Yesuusa woyasinnee fa tamaaritayis yhay garkke yeegeeza.
«Higge asitamaaritaynnee Ferisaawe asay Muse higge tamarisodayis Muse oyidela betteeza.
Yey gishos, u yinttan azaziza baz ubbita oothoyttannee naagoytta. Zin u oothizay garkke oothippate. Abis giiko, u odizay garkk oothooya.
Unttii tookkin dendoowa deexo toofo accii as toossiza. Zin paasi hara attozin, ye toofo asay tookkodar biradhdhe xeerar bochchodayis koyooya.
«Zin u fa ooso ubba asii be7aday garkk oothiza. Fa sinollannee qeseel acciz maxxaafe xiqise yez kiitappe dalggisiza, fa afila macarakka adussiza.
Mokkinttiza aqo bonchcho aqonne Ayihuditay Woosa keetha gaame lo77iza oyde dosiza.
Asay gabe gancce unttan bonchchor sarothodanannee ‹Asitamaarayyo› gi xeegod garkk koyiza.
«Zin yi asitamaaray pettay aadda maaqqeez gishonnee yi ubbitay e ishita maaqqeez gishos ‹Asitamaarayyo› ginttinttii xeeginttippate.
Yinttis salo pettii aday aadda yez gishos yha sa7a oonakka ‹adayyo› gi xeegppatte.
Yinttis pettii Goday Kiristtoosa aadda yeza gishos ‹Goda› ginttinttii xeeginttippate.
Yinttapp aadhizay yinttis aylle maaqqo.
Fana dhoqqi udiz oonkka kawuzhoda; fana kawuzhisiza oonkka dhoqqi goda.
Higge asitamaaritaynnee Ferisaawe asitay borintteeza
«Yinttanno, cubbittayyo, higge asitamaaritaynnee Ferisaawttayyo, as tiina salo kaatetitha gorddizitayyo yinttan ayye. Yinttii, yi ubbas gelaamii ma yhankkitakka gelsaamii.
[«Yinttanno cubbitayyo, higge asitamaaritaynnee, Ferisaawttayyo, am7itay keetha yi bonqqittar, asii be7o gi woosa adussiza. Yey gishos, yinttan ayye. Ubbapp aadhiz pirdday yinttan naagiza.]

«Yinttanno, cubbittayyo, higge asitamaaritaynnee Ferisaawttayyo, yinttii pettii atha ammanthodayis abarannee sa7ar yuuyiza. Zin yi eza ammantheez wode ye atha yinttipp aathii Gaannames giigsiza ooso oothiza gishos yinttan ayye.
«Oonkka Xooss Keetha caaqqiko akkokka baaya. Zin Xooss Keetha yez worqqa caaqqiko, ye caaqay ezis gomoda giz to7itayyo, yi ubbas to7ii hara as kaalithizitayyo, yinttan ayye.
Yinttanno, boozitayyo, to7itayyo, worqqay aadhinenee? Worqqa Xoossayis dummasiza Xooss Keethay aadhee?
Ma ‹Oonkka yarshsho yarshshiza aqo caaqqiko, akkokka baaya. Zin oonkka ezal afa yeza yarshsha caaqqiko, ye caaqay ees gomoda› yeegii taamarssiza.
Yinttanno, tullitayyo to7itayyo, yarshsho aadhinenee? Yarshsho Xoossayis dummasiza aqay aadhee?
Yey gishos, yarshsho aqayir caaqqiza athay, ye yarshsho bessaaydanne ezal afa yeza ubbabazal caaqqiza.
Xooss Keetha caaqqiza athay, ye Xooss Keeth giddonnee ezayid yeza Xoossa caaqqiza.
Salo caaqqiza athay Xooss zufaanannee ye zufaanayil afa bettiz Xoossa caaqqiza.

«Yinttanno, cubbitayyo, higge asitamaaritayyonnee Ferisaawttayyo, yinttan ayye. Yi karthi gaallapp, shaashincheppennee booth gaallapp asiraata kessiza. Zin higgayid yez aadhii koshshizita ashshiza: yeykka luule pirdde, qadhdheene ubbabazal ammanintto. Harabazitakka ashshekkazar yhayttita yi oothodayis beeziza.
Yinttis to7ii hara as kaalithizitayyo, yi ushshapp wununo kessii gimaale mittiza.
«Yinttanno, cubbitayyo, higge asitamaaritayyonnee Ferisaawe assayyo, yinttan ayye. Yi shaatessinnee keres afa bagga geeshshiza. Zin gancce baggay bonqqannee uuzatithii kumeeza.
Neno to7a Ferisaawayyo, shaatesinnee keres gancce tiina geeshshoba. Yeypp guye, afa baggaykka geeshshii maaqqada.
«Yinttanno, cubbitayyo, higge asitamaaritayyonnee Ferisaawttayyo, yinttan ayye. Afa baggar borshonttor lo77ii, gancce meqqethinnee wooqqeezibaz kumeez duufo aaziza.
Yey garkkekka, afa baggar asis lo77o aaziza. Zin yi gancce cubbotithinnee iitatithii kumeeza.
«Yinttanno, cubbitayyo, higge asitamaaritayyonnee Ferisaawitayyo, yinttan ayye. Yi nabitayis duufo ginbbiza, ma xillitay duufakka lo7ithiza.
Ma yinttii, ‹Nuunii binii nu aditay wode yeza baz maaqqeezako, unttar wolla nabitay suuthi laalamizin› yeegiza.
Yey gishos, yi nabita wodhdheez as na7ita maaqqeezana yinttii yi ubbas markkattiza.
Yeezako, yi aditay aykkeezana yi poloytta.
«Yha shooshuntho, goppe na7untho, yi Gaanname pirddapp wayizii attodee?

Yey gishos, ta odizana si7oytta; taanii nabita, eca asitannee asitamaarita yinttiko kiittoda. Unttapp petta petta yi wodhoda mazqqalel afa sottoda. Baggita Ayihuditay Woosa keetha gelissii alangoda katamapp katama bayi7oda.
Yey gishos, xilla Aabeela wodhdheez wodepp aykkii, Xooss Keethissinnee yarshsho aqopp giddo yi wodhdheez Barakiyu na7a Zakkireesa suuthii hellodar yhayqqeez geesh as ubbay gishos yi seerinttoda.
Taanii yinttis turo odiza; yinttinnee yi aditay ootheez buutayis yha pirdda ubbay yha yeletithayil afa helloda.
Yesuusa Yerusalaames yeekkeeza

«Yerusalaame, Yerusalaame, nabita wodhizannee! Xoossay neeko kiitteezita shuchchar shocizannee! Shugula fa na7ita fa qefer haphphizay garkk taanii ne na7ita ta shiishodayis aappun toke koyennee! Zin tana ne kayeeza.
Yikkee, yi keethay kaysa maaqqada.
Taanii yinttis odiza; ‹Goday sunthar yi7izay anjjintteezaya› yi god gatho yhaypp guye tana yi be7aamii» yeegeeza.

footnotes.text: Sinollannee qesell acciz maxxaafe ... afila maccara adussiza: Yeya u oothizay Xoossayis ta ingintteezaya gi fana beessadayis (Nam7i. 15:37-41).
Pettii pettii binii maxaafitay tayibo 14 gujjiza.
